scope: Art study only; not accepted for the complete furniture library.

method.player: Windows64 development, instrumented, Direct3D11, visible window
method.aggregate: Median of six segment medians; paired deltas compare repetitions. rawP95 is pooled within each condition.

variants.0: A original FlatLit; skips per-frame material property updates
variants.2: C dark top and light-facing matte edge; same shader and update loop as B

method.denseFixture: 60 runtime clones, scale .35, grid 10x6, original three hidden. One stationary handheld beam/spill; optional 3 ceiling lights. Controller updates 63 sample entries including hidden originals.
method.resolutionLimit: Requested 3840x2160 window was clamped to 1920x1200; no 4K claim.
method.counters: GPU only fresh FrameTimingManager timestamps with positive duration. Main Thread includes waits; Render Thread recorder unavailable. No pure CPU execution claim.
limits: Synthetic fixture, not a gameplay level or hardware scalability guarantee.
Height-aware shadows and shadows onto other furniture are not implemented or measured.
B and C intentionally share shader arithmetic; disabling rim by coefficient is not a shader specialization.
Shadows-off scenario follows shadows-on scenarios; its large GPU difference is a diagnostic rather than a separately randomized shadow benchmark.

validation.fullBuildWarnings: Six pre-existing obsolete API warnings from EnvironmentLoadProbe.cs; final incremental build zero warnings.
